note: EXAMPLE ONLY, published to show the format. A real private run config, and the plugins that define its held-out domains and genres, must NOT be published or committed to a public repository before the evaluation: anyone who sees them can tune a model to the held-out sets. Keep them private, draw a fresh random nonce for every config (python -c "import secrets; print(secrets.token_hex(16))"), publish only the commitment that cli.py generate records in the run's manifest, and reveal the config after the evaluation, when anyone can check it with: python cli.py verify-config RUN_DIR CONFIG. Plugin paths are relative to this file. This example holds out the test-only toy domain and toy genre of tests/, which are public and hide nothing from anyone: use it to demo the held-out metrics offline, e.g. python cli.py demo --mix random --private-config configs/private.example.json
